**Democrats need to flip six House seats to retake the majority, and that path runs right through FL-13 with Whitney Fox’s campaign.**
Whitney is a working mother dedicated to addressing the affordability crisis, improving health care access for veterans and seniors, and creating jobs to make the economy work for everyone.
In short, she’s exactly the candidate we need to flip swing districts like FL-13 and elect Democratic majorities to the House **and** Senate next year.
**[If you can spare just $3 to split between our campaign and Whitney’s, it will help Whitney’s campaign win this flippable seat, eliminate one of Trump’s biggest backers in Congress, and secure a new Democratic majority. And it’s up to all of us to fight back. Thanks for doing your part today.

# **URGENT: Will You Stand with Me?**********
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,

I’m not going to sugarcoat it: I really need your help.

**We’re dangerously close to missing our October fundraising deadline. We’ve got to raise $55,000 by the end of this month, or we’ll fall short of our goal. **

**[Will you stand with me? Will you give $50, $30, or even just $10 to help grow our campaign?](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=f88fdad2e2&e=0be619cbaa)**

My campaign isn’t financed by special interests. I’m relying on the support of real Americans like you who are fed up with the status quo. They’re looking for courageous, common-sense solutions to the problems facing our great country, not more lip service and broken promises.

After all, you and I both know we can’t afford to lose this election. Now, more than ever, America needs strong leadership. The incompetence of the Biden-Harris Administration has emboldened America’s enemies and weakened our allies. And even as the threat of terrorism increases every day, our southern border remains wide open.

It’s time we stopped apologizing to our enemies and started putting America First. With your help, we can stop this madness. We can secure our border, strengthen our support for our allies, and defeat anyone who seeks to harm us.

**[But I can’t do it without your help. So please, give what you can - any amount makes a big difference! - TODAY. ](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=b92759b8af&e=0be619cbaa)**

Together, we can usher in a new Golden Age for America. It begins with winning the GOP nomination for president, and then, the White House. And we just can’t do it without you.

Thank you,

Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President

Hello,
After the 2022 election, my husband Adam Frisch and I went to Washington for “freshman orientation” for new members of Congress.
We still didn’t know whether or not Adam had defeated Lauren Boebert. We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72120419/434374115/1610638071?refcode=em20231024pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=ac024c17-cc72-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzAyNGMxNy1jYzcyLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gmB8auem0u5o4FUm54nBXnM3kVMhCWS0w_00CPOP5nw=)
Ultimately, though, after all the votes were counted, Adam came up short. We lost to Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and this time, I know he can win. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022.
**During the last campaign, we got out-spent by Lauren Boebert and her Super PACs – by millions and millions of dollars.** It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads.
You see, Lauren Boebert is one of the best fundraisers in Congress. Her extreme, far-right base funnels millions to her campaign. But Adam doesn’t take money from corporate PACs – never has, never will.
**If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and defeat Lauren Boebert this time, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now.**

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, big news!

At 6pm PT / 9pm ET TONIGHT (Oct. 24th), Our Revolution will hold a LIVE Healthcare for All Town Hall with Reps. Barbara Lee, Ro Khanna and Pramila Jayapal, the chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, along with CA Assemblyman Ash Kalra.

https://ourrevolution.zoom.us/j/993867009

JOIN HERE! (https://ourrevolution.zoom.us/j/993867009)

We’ll talk about CalCare single payer healthcare in California and the path to national Medicare for All, as well as medical debt, drug prices, and how we can chart a path to healthcare justice in America.

The Live Town Hall event kicks off at 6pm Pacific/9pm Eastern TONIGHT! Use this link to join: https://ourrevolution.zoom.us/j/993867009

We are thrilled to have this powerful lineup of healthcare justice champions working alongside Our Revolution and our progressive movement for universal healthcare in California and beyond.

Healthcare is a human right, and it’s long past time for America to adopt a single payer system. Winning CalCare would be a huge step forward in advancing the fight for Medicare for All nationwide.

Join Barbara Lee, Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal, Ash Kalra, and our progressive coalition TONIGHT for this LIVE Healthcare for All town hall! Use this link to join the call: https://ourrevolution.zoom.us/j/993867009

Hope to see you there!

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
OCTOBER 24, 2023

CONTACT: [press@kevinfaulconer.com](mailto:press@kevinfaulconer.com)

# Faulconer Issues Statement Supporting Proposition 13 to Protect Families from Higher Property Taxes
#
SAN DIEGO, CA – Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for County Supervisor in District Three, issued a statement following Terra Lawson-Remer’s refusal to support shielding San Diego County from higher property taxes in the midst of record inflation.

“Tonight, Terra Lawson-Remer refused to support keeping families in their homes and preventing a property tax hike. In the midst of crushing inflation, a tax hike is the last thing our county needs,” said former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for district three Supervisor. “We don’t need absent leadership right now; we need to reassure every family by letting them know we won’t allow tax hikes that will push them out of their homes at a time when everything is so expensive. San Diego already ranks number one as the most expensive place to live in the country and Terra Lawson-Remer continues to take votes to make things more expensive. I’m going to change that when I’m elected Supervisor.”

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago – an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

subject: The leftist cabal destroying America since 2008
body:
Remember when gas prices were under $1.50 per gallon?

| |
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5bthb42vo7cm1nn46v7gu9r7gou5r8nl90etd10_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9h61o36c5h2bs)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Dane County had a great turnout at their Farm Team Training! We appreciate everyone who showed up to help us set the stage for success in 2024. **Grant County**
Grant County hosted their annual Lincoln Day Dinner, where they were joined by Wisconsin Republican Party Chairman, Brian Schimming. The event proved to be a huge success, as Grant County Republicans came to support the GOP and our goals for the upcoming year. **Green County**
Green County hosted a beautiful reception for their Lincoln Day Dinner. Green County Republicans were joined by former Wisconsin Governor, Tommy Thompson. **Jefferson County**
The Jefferson County Republican Party hosted Chairman Brian Schimming and State Treasurer John Lieber to kick off their Annual Fall Festival. Republicans from across the county mobilized to enjoy each other's company and gear up for the upcoming elections! **Juneau County**
Juneau County hosted a great Lincoln Day Dinner. Members of the Republican Party of Juneau County showed up to listen to speakers and enjoy the company of fellow patriots! **Kenosha County**
Representative Amanda Nedweski joined RPW Chairman Schimming and members of the Kenosha County Republican Party at an amazing event hosted by Chairwoman Sandy Wiedmeyer. We are so grateful to have such strong women leading our county parties! **Ozaukee County**
Former Governor Scott Walker joined the members of the Ozaukee County Republican Party to launch its new Young Republicans chapter! Ozaukee County is working to ensure that all young people continue to have their voices heard. **Richland County**
Richland County hosted a fantastic Pints and Politics Events. Richland County Republicans came together to show support for the GOP while spending time among friends! **Rusk County**
Wisconsin's finest joined the Rusk Republican Party at their Annual Republican Dinner. Congressman Tom Tiffany attended the dinner, where he thanked Rusk County Republicans for their unwavering support of the GOP! **St. Croix County**
The St. Croix County Republican Party hosted an incredible Reagan Reunion Dinner, where they heard from a multitude of speakers, including Congressman Tom Tiffany. The dinner was a testament to the fact that the Republican Party will continue the legacy of our predecessors and never cease to fight our our amazing country! **St. Croix County**
On October 13, St. Croix County Republicans mobilized to fight for the American taxpayer and government transparency. The GOP will always fight for our constituents' First Amendment rights; we hear the concerns of Wisconsinites! **Walworth County**
Members of the Walworth County Republican Party showed up to Oktoberfest to encourage citizens to register to vote. It is because of people like our friends in Walworth that the Republican Party continues to win elections! **Washington County **
Slinger Firefighter, Ken Reiser, was presented the First Responder of the Year Award by State Senators Rick Gundrum and Duey Stroebel. Our legislators will always fight for the men and women who risk our lives every day to protect us and our communities. We thank Mr. Reiser for his years of service! **Winnebago County**
The Republican Party of Winnebago County hosted a luncheon on October 14th where they had the opportunity to discuss current events! ## House GOP Nominates Mike Johnson
The House Speaker race was back to ground zero Tuesday night, as the third nominee, House Majority Whip Tom Emmer, [proved unable to come up with enough votes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D9vgzAQBfBPYzbQ-fwHMnjo4i1dOyLHPpKrTIyME9RvX9G525Pek37S-7rO18CZn_fPsJJrS5lDbPymWUKPpkc16y65hQhJdeSkvUyoJmOxe7horbGLJLyNiRTqKUY1EhCOEKOcTMcOAZUENHAxRo6D1TKgNSam2y0avAgNlLiVOnwXfrYHLfmnvKkOsaxddo_Wtl2oD4FeoD-OY9hK5saxnAOBPvOb-teWQqNdoD81gV7CmbVAH8vzXmk_O1pXqn2qZdv78mo9gESlwHbVpe3gnHm3o9BwXwPnP7_9f8dvAAAA___ZYl6A) and withdrew just hours after being nominated. At least [25 Republicans said they wouldn't vote](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyqzAQQNGvgW4ZsUKAC4rX0Pm1KRkhFrOx0GokxSR_n0nq1Le5c97uy92y5_D4b0-ayi6LdYVftLQK0ADqpau3aSdC0jVNbX8bUY-mx_qYtBm1GfbR6oFUb_W6Kz3SYHXrxm50Q80TKtStQqNuxrRD03etxd4Yt62rM3irOkUbF0nNu3AoB-3-S16UGidn7aejlJgr_a_CucL5uq5ml89AV_7pFc5RPBd2ucL5kI9M8JAIOXKyPgOHIuAOKxlsBjpPSrCSk5MylIPTBjmSfVKCICcHItiSxEgbcIByJCK4iJ65TtMWL_aecz9UnXqclv3vYPnb6zsAAP__A2dvrg) for Emmer, and he could afford to lose only four votes. He follows previous nominees Steve Scalise and Jim Jordan in failing to win enough support. Last night, the GOP conference held another candidate forum to hear from six candidates, and it [nominated Rep. Mike Johnson](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDHPpCAQQH-NdhgYBbWwuMZur73SIIw6uwgGZtfcv7_s1V_3kte8vD-P5WEpUNx_2xMn3tJiHdMHFyUFaAHt0tV-2hAB2xonZcYB2kEbqI-pVcZK43FDDbaTm1S9xnFs-8H7AUdT0wQSWiVBy1Fr1TemUxaM1s6vq9MwVp1ET5xy80wU-cAt_E0fzI1LZx2mg_kqVfurgrmC-b7vJq4u4l2-voL5SoGYXKlgdinuGcsXM17vNZCzsYiYToqWUZz0QvFMRywpiiO9C4pyoX1hFsEyFhaWGc-LxZrRvsQusotWAUg11nny100hUDF91cn9tBT-J_LPx_4FAAD___SXb6M) (R-LA). After the vote (in which he receieved 128 votes, far more than any other candidate), Johnson said he's "very confident" he can get the 217 votes he needs on the House floor.
## Tucker Signs PublicSq as First Big Sponsor
Tucker Carlson [officially signed his first big sponsorship deal](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskT-P3CAQxT8N7ljBYPyncLHaxN1eikRKuRrj8ZoEgwXcea_JZ4-WlVKler8nmPekmZ_X2xWts_7-hhsNeQk3NNl-0E0KDpqDutXVPCxEQKqiQTZ9B6rTDVTrYBZBKLFDNTU9Ne1Ua61N19fQylouXWUHEKCkAC16rWV7amqJ0Ght5mkyGnpWC5ptDvH0K1ifV1rcZ_igeDJhq9yw5rwnps4MRgbjcRwn4yfzfGQwPqMZjFI8uWYw5nfzmyI3GF0Knid794kvNqbMceYzoePJekN8CQ_u6Uh8ph1jfo90WvPmGCimzn-YOmd6ZKa-jCFuFBloEGN4FH2jIxVYQ8oFfpTWgpdXM4P29cfTUXSj2WIhE7Yd_ecrARODS16pONz3f3OXr9-eeinmas2K5Ap_J7tQzFUc5v2wztnUtKwW9w2tKyvL_7_g3wAAAP__vdSU0Q), finalizing a partnership with PublicSq, an online marketplace for companies with conservative values. Preliminary details were first reported in July, just before PublicSq went public. It's valued at more than $1 million and represents PublicSq's first major marketing push since going public. The ads are set to air on Carlson's show on X, formerly Twitter, [starting in November](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUQOGngY0IX34cDwxdvKVrRwvDdbgtNimQpH37qp07n-FI39tluXjKdFxf_Y6ub2XxodMDl0EKMALUonl0GyKg4ugGO51BnY0FnpzXatJRSqOVXv0mTQwq6vNoB7QRwHNyIEENEoycjBnGk9WDB2tMiOsaDExMS4zUSz29Fzp6wi1_lwfWUyg7zy71fmtMvTCYGcw9YaKcfxuDOZUdD3w2BvOOkTyDWcOopJWi38MHVhF8za0c4nZfM4X2efcVxUa1deHjA2unhlV8MZh5dfH2pJyp2ZFped09_X14_5_kJwAA___9GmLN) and continuing through the 2024 election. On X, Carlson regularly racks up tens of millions of views.
## Diamondbacks, Rangers Set For World Series
The Texas Rangers and the Arizona Diamondbacks will face off in the World Series after Arizona beat the Philadelphia Phillies 4-2 Tuesday night in the deciding game for the National League pennant. It's the Rangers' third visit to the World Series, most recently in 2011. They're one of [six baseball teams ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskbGO3CAQhp8Gd1h4MNguXKwSubsU0UkpV2MY20QYVoCOuybPHq03Zbpv5h_pk-b_9XZ_Q-dd2H_gSXPZ4h1NcR907wQHxUHe-8bOGxGQbGju9DSCHJWG5piREJDWQQitulEYawdJY69lZ8Zh0ti4GQTIToASk1Ld0Oq-Q9BKGbuuRsHEekHWlZja39GFctDmv-IHpdbEs_HzUcojM3ljsDBYaq1tWI3d6jNmsASqmcGSHzGVJ5x-ZbAU-sTME4adUuY1Jm95puQo85VSObhNWDN_JHSZ-JbiyU-_vg4ZLFLqYYLpUkomb3-YvBX6LEx-fz-IgQLx_jRc9PNluRjTK42BGHyrLvxbV_y64Gm6wBwYdhf2aygHlrZJs31U573LemC92E90_vpB-X8lfwMAAP__MOaJwg)that have never won a Series title. The Series begins this Friday at the Rangers' home field in Arlington, Texas. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: battleground update!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

With the vote over Ohio’s _Issue 1_ abortion referendum rapidly approaching on November 7th, you’ve likely heard about all about our efforts to make sure Ohioans **_REJECT_** the Abortion Lobby’s attempt to impose late-term abortion on the state.

But with everything going on over in the Buckeye State, I don’t want you to forget about our other **_HUGE_** 2023 battleground state – **_Virginia!_**

One recent Christopher Newport University (CNU) poll I just saw shows that abortion is the NUMBER-ONE issue for Virginia Democrats!

Democrat legislators know this, which is why they’ve been campaigning on nothing but abortion for months.

So, a loss here on Election Day would be devastating to the Abortion Lobby – _especially considering that President Biden won the state by 10% in 2020!_

**[So, would you please consider making your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to _Students for Life Action_ right away to help all of our plans going on in Virginia right now](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-syukktl-duchtdja-y/)?**

The good news is, earlier this summer, _Students for Life Action_ launched a comprehensive three-part plan for the Old Dominion, which included:

**>>> ** **_Campus Activism_.**
Voter registration and engagement among young people has been a difficult task for Republicans, as the younger generation typically skews Left as a voting demographic.

The good news is that reaching this generation is one of _Students for Life Action's_ greatest strengths! In fact, we’ve already found we can convert 10% of the pro- abortion/on-the-fence young people we talk to in-person – and 20% of those we talk to online!
**>>> ** **_Door-to-Door Canvassing_.**
We have found that even just a few activists knocking on hundreds or thousands of doors can make all the difference in competitive races from small state legislative races to statewide campaigns. Though state legislative districts are smaller than federal ones, they often are the key to passing or defeating pro-life legislation and saving thousands of lives in states across the nation.
**>>> ** **_Digital and Text Message Outreach_.**
Our goal this election season is to reach a total of 287,150 targeted voters in Virginia through our **Vote Pro-Life First Digital Campaign** which will focus on first time, 18-35 year-old voters.

Working hand in hand with our digital ad campaign will be our personal pear-to-peer text messages, which studies have shown can increase election day turnout by between .07 to 3 percentage points.
Seeing how these efforts in Virginia pay off will be a harbinger for what we’ll need to do across the country in 2024.

But of course, none of this would have been possible without the generous support of good folks like you.

**[So, if you could chip in $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to help us DOUBLE our efforts before Virginia’s November 7th elections, it would be a HUGE shot in the arm for the pro-life movement](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-syukktl-duchtdja-j/)!**

I think the best part of our plan so far is that it’s working!

In fact, one of our students who was door-knocking in Virginia Beach has a personal story to prove it:

_“I went up to this house and a man answered, so I asked him if he was going to vote for Karen Greenhalgh, and he said yes, we are going to. He then asked me if I was with Students for Life, so I said yes, and he said that his kids were a part of it! He told me that I was doing a good job and that he knows that this can be a contentious subject, but he said to not get discouraged, and keep up the good work.”_
You see, the Abortion Lobby thinks they have the Old Dominion wrapped around their finger.

But they don’t know what you and I know, Pro-Life Friend.

We’ve been working hard to reclaim Virginia as a pro-life state, and we’ve been making leaps and bounds of progress!

But I need you to dig deep if we’re going to pull it all off.

**[So please make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s_ Virginia Plan so we can strike fear into the Abortion Lobby come 2024](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-syukktl-duchtdja-i/)!**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – As expected, the Abortion Lobby isn’t going down without a fight in Virginia, so that’s why it’s our job to give them the toughest fight possible – _one they** _WON’T_** recover from!_

The good news is, earlier this summer, _Students for Life Action_ launched a comprehensive three-part plan for the Old Dominion, and it’s making lots of progress!

But to ensure a sweeping pro-life victory, I need you to dig deep if we’re going to pull it all off.

**[So, if you could chip in $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to help us DOUBLE our efforts before Virginia’s November 7th elections, it would be a HUGE shot in the arm for the pro-life movement](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-syukktl-duchtdja-d/)!**

Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

Friend,
Populism
is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think
about American politics as being divided between the Left and the
Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been
seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat
and Republican establishment.

And
believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back
to Roman times.

That's
why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to
make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks:
Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson.

Hanson is
a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think
you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important
eBook, you'll learn more about:

What
we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that
rebel against both the establishment-and each other.
The
important parallels between these ancient movements and their
modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative
populism.
What
lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our
culture.

| | | | | I’m (almost) at a loss for words sharing this announcement with you, Peter: President Joe Biden just announced the creation of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. This win couldn’t have happened without the non-stop work of young leaders and activists across the country, including everyone at March For Our Lives. After four long years of protests, registering thousands of young voters, meeting after meeting, and MANY Zoom calls...we did it!!! I’ll share more about the work young leaders did to get us to this point, but first: [Please split a donation of $10 today between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action to help carry this momentum forward and elect the leaders we deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4d768ec4-a364-4aec-acf1-61de3ea06326/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Here’s why we can draw a direct line from our work to the Biden administration’s new Office of Gun Violence Prevention, Peter. When we talk about electing the “leaders we deserve,” we’re talking about folks like Maxwell Frost, one of our Advisory Board members and the first Gen-Z Member of Congress. Maxwell served as the first National Organizing Director for March For Our Lives and really helped us level-up our organizing work, especially on behalf of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. We did everything from asking presidential candidates about opening that department if they were elected at our 2020 Gun Safety Forum to sleeping on an office floor in the Virginia House of Delegates to ensure we were able to lobby on behalf of gun violence prevention, while armed white supremacists pointed guns at them through windows. The very first bill he introduced on the House floor was to establish a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Republicans blocked it, but he didn’t give up, and neither did we. Even when it became clear that NRA-sponsored politicians weren’t going to let his bill pass, President Biden stepped in. In fact, Vice President Kamala Harris introduced Maxwell at the official announcement of the Office of GVP, and Maxwell got to introduce President Biden!! And when we talk about leveraging the power of the youth vote, we’re talking about years of record-breaking youth voting turnout that led us to this announcement. In the last five years, we went from having the most pro-NRA president in American history to the most pro-gun safety president in American history. Young people were critical in electing Biden. Our voices and votes matter. But we need to elect more young people to make sure we build power on the inside and outside of politics [Help us carry this momentum and get more life-saving sh*t done by splitting a donation of $10 between Blue Amp Action and Leaders We Deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5055bfba-323b-4c7b-bf18-32e7c37ea0d2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [CHIP IN $10 OR MORE NOW!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5c1e6e44-465b-4ece-9400-8701fc0fcacc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We should celebrate this momentous victory, Peter — but it doesn’t mean we can slow down or stop anytime soon. There is still so much work to be done, from tackling the climate crisis to expanding abortion access to building a country that isn’t run by the rich and powerful few. There is a long road ahead of us, and we need your help if we’re going to score more wins, elect more young people to office, and stop the fascist takeover of our country. Dear Friends,

After three weeks of discussions and debates, the House of Representatives may have found a new Speaker that we can all get behind. The Republican Conference voted for Rep. Mike Johnson of Louisiana. I support this and I hope you will too.

Rep. Johnson is a good conservative who served on the Armed Services Committee, and voted against additional funding of Ukraine in their war that has little strategic interest to our country. He has supported the America First agenda and was a consistent ally to President Trump.

The grassroots wanted Rep. Jordan but we will settle for Rep. Johnson. We need a Speaker who will focus on domestic issues while not giving in to the D.C. Swamp. Rep. Johnson has proven he'll do that. We can count on him.

Call your congressional delegation and let them know that you support Rep. Mike Johnson of Louisiana for Speaker of the House.

the denial of the license.”

Hi there,
You may know me from TV and movies, but today I’m popping into your inbox to team up with Fair Fight, as they work to protect and expand the freedom to vote in upcoming elections.
I’m a proud Latina, and I’ve seen firsthand how our community has too often been ignored and silenced. That’s why I co-founded Poderistas, a non-profit organization created by and for Latinas to engage our communities in key elections and ignite social change throughout the nation.
Latinas are CEOs of workplaces. We’re the backbone of our households. We make important decisions for ourselves and our families. And yet, we make up less than 2 percent of elected officials nationwide, and we face persistent barriers to accessing the ballot box — because some extremist politicians fear the power we hold.
**I believe it’s our collective duty to continue fighting for a democracy that includes and values each of us, and that’s the work Fair Fight is doing day in and day out.[Before I tell you more, I’m asking you to pitch in to ensure that Fair Fight can continue building voting power for and electing people of color — in Georgia and beyond.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72126529/434410751/1358700588?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20231025_f_americaferrera_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNmJjYjJmZi0zNTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D6YCz909BeoVUna87N0jRlOElzuJ97KFWDgezzi4iXA=)**
[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72126533/434410753/1358700588?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20231025_f_americaferrera_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNmJjYjJmZi0zNTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D6YCz909BeoVUna87N0jRlOElzuJ97KFWDgezzi4iXA=)

Our vote determines our futures. And by shutting us out of the voting process, extremists are denying us a fair say in the issues that directly affect us, from the makeup of our school boards to our access to reproductive healthcare. They know exactly what they’re doing because they’ve seen how Latinas have influenced — or even determined — the outcomes of past elections.
But the issue goes deeper. We can advocate against voter suppression laws and have all the voter registration drives we want, but until storytelling about who Latinas are and what we’re worth begins to change, we’re going to continue fighting an uphill battle.
**We need our leaders to invest in our communities, invest in hearing our stories, and invest in our futures. **
Fair Fight is an important ally in that mission. Through voter mobilization, education, and advocacy, they put marginalized voices at the forefront of their efforts to protect the freedom to vote, they help elect diverse pro-voter candidates, and they combat the voter suppression that has become so rampant in Georgia and across the country.
[**There’s a lot at stake in this year’s local and statewide elections, and in next year’s presidential election cycle, so today I’m asking you to pitch in anything you can to fuel Fair Fight’s work toward a stronger, more inclusive democracy.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72126536/434410757/1358700588?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20231025_f_americaferrera_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNmJjYjJmZi0zNTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D6YCz909BeoVUna87N0jRlOElzuJ97KFWDgezzi4iXA=)

As I adjusted to life and high school in a new country, my mom worked double shifts to support our family. But even still, it was a struggle to pay the bills and afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
When I turned 15, I got a job at a local doughnut shop. **It was hard work, but it's what my family needed to make ends meet.**
I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my opponent, Rick Scott, **_bought_** two doughnut shops.

While I was a teen making minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, Rick Scott was an owner.

**For me, the doughnuts represent a lifeline that helped my family afford rent. ****For Rick Scott, they represent the beginning of his private corporate career.**
I went on to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Rick Scott went on to oversee the largest Medicare fraud in the nation’s history, amass a fortune of hundreds of millions, and buy a Senate seat.

This week the Institute for Legislative Analysis (ILA) released their comprehensive review of state legislators.
> The ILA, ". . . serves as the data and policy hub for national conservative and liberty-minded organizations. ILA was established earlier this year, with its launch event attended by over 50 members of Congress who are the most philosophically committed to limited government. Prior to the launch of the ILA, the team previously served together for nearly a decade at CPAC and the American Conservative Union where they constructed the nation's first 50 state legislative scorecard."
The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is proud to announce that four of the top lawmakers who consistently voted for limited government, more freedom and lower taxes were members of the caucus. These members included; Steve Hopkins, [Chris Brown](https://substack.com/redirect/93913de1-471c-4d3d-80b6-5eb7182fac3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Joel Bomgar,](https://substack.com/redirect/77400d37-b0b6-4592-a2ae-759e7f5df352?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Dana Criswell](https://substack.com/redirect/22a9e5b4-909a-4985-b85e-a3473a10d2ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [All four scored above 90%](https://substack.com/redirect/b27d05f7-c26a-4b78-a2f4-17f601155c5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), proving their commitment to the conservative principles that make our state and nation great.
Sadly, other than the five top scores no other legislator in Mississippi scored above 80%. The ILA wrote in their analysis, "In fact, an astonishing **91 out of 112** Republican lawmakers received ratings below 50%, meaning they voted more often with the liberal position on policy than they did with the conservative position.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: The importance of a dollar.
body:
I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi7vilhjrv5kh5l2saue6kg7keqhtn66mc2om1q8_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9imcoj2c3h2bs)
---

I am a mom and an accountant, Friend, which means I know how to stretch a dollar.

That's why, on day one, I made sure our team knew that the success of our movement relies on grassroots supporters like YOU. With that, comes a responsibility to make every dollar count and spend your donations wisely.

Unlike other campaigns that are burning through money on private planes, fancy dinners, and country clubs, **we are a lean and mean operation.**

We stretch every dollar as far as it can go and know it's important to spend our money when it counts. But even covering basic expenses to host town halls and travel to battleground states to meet with voters adds up.

**[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zg17p2t9o39oqosrb682sdkog0tatus60ee4gd1o_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9imcoj2c3h2bs "That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win! ")**

Here are just a couple meaningful ways your contribution has helped our team:

**-> TRAVELING:** From day one, I've prioritized meeting with voters, shaking every hand, and amplifying my message everywhere I can. In order to do that, my team and I are flying all over the country, and we're doing it while spending money wisely.

I can tell you firsthand, we're not out here lighting money on fire with private planes and extravagant luxury hotels like some campaigns. We're flying a lot of Spirit and JetBlue. We're getting to New Hampshire, Iowa, and everywhere else we need to go with the most affordable options we can find.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi570kfh5ipefgs988r6l5emf5aibtkq8h616hq0_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9imcoj2c3h2bs)
---

**-> EVENTS:** We're running a true grassroots campaign, and that means being on the ground, holding as many grassroots events as possible. Every time we hold a town hall in Iowa, South Carolina, or New Hampshire, it's an opportunity to share my vision, answer questions, and gain the confidence of voters.

But what you may not realize is that all of the costs can quickly add up to rent the event space, chairs, and sound equipment. In order to spend your money wisely, we're holding these events at places like bakeries, local venues, and farms.

---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z43ak2b1mqmumv7019k0bd2jq49qp3a2dm3j7h38_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9imcoj2c3h2bs)
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ze4892pcj5gkt25tup9gm9sad1jjsvt0qb0umbq8_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9imcoj2c3h2bs)
---
At the end of the day, this is a tried and true grassroots operation. Our staff is lean and mean and you better believe we're working every hour of the day and spending every dollar wisely. But all of this still costs money, which is why we need your help.

Once the first-in-the-nation caucus is here, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the country begins to cast their ballots.

It's a marathon and we've got to stay on pace to win each and every day. **[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1o3u6voefvavuivrr098mgp58uoo0ms7vbghnao_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9imcoj2c3h2bs "That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!")**

---
| | [CONTRIBUTE $20.24](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsifh1qq5jsgdf17af3v3p9kqql24tfep5k4k8uo_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9imcoj2c3h2bs)
---

**It 's crunch time, Friend!** There's no room for holding back. With just **88 days** left until voting begins every single day matters which is why I appreciate your generous support today when it matters most.
---

My very best,

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.
**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztce62rqp77ok6d65llu07tt6bvla7h23eq9llfo_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9imcoj2c3h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

You’re growing, learning, understanding, and slowly but surely, evolving into the person you eventually become.

That’s why my great-grandmother, Maebel James, is so important to me. Ever since I was little, she taught me that it’s our responsibility to help others, even when it isn’t easy.

If you don’t like something, she’d say, “Go farther and do better.” That message has been my north star during my time in public service. And it’s this call to service that led me to run for Senate in this competitive race here in Maryland.

**Together, we’re going to go farther and do better so that future generations have safe communities, a healthy and habitable planet, and a system that benefits working families.**

So even though I’m sharing a throwback with you, I want to be clear that my message in this race is about moving Maryland _forward_. I need your help right now making that vision a reality, Peter.

#

Here at GIFFORDS, we focus on facts.
And here’s a cold, hard truth for you: over 43,000 people die from gun violence each year in America.
The NRA wants you to believe that buying a gun is the best way to protect yourself.
But if more guns meant more safety, the United States would be the safest country in the world, yet we have far more violence than our peer countries.
The NRA doesn’t care about safer communities. Their priority is using scare tactics to sell more guns and line the pockets of their top executives.
Our movement is made up of gun owners and non-gun owners alike who believe that we can—and must—do more to protect our communities from preventable violence, not just fuel gun industry profits.
It’s up to us to fight back against the gun lobby’s harmful disinformation. While they may use fear and lies to rile up their base, we will always use hope and truth as our guiding light in the movement to end gun violence.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: This isn't over ... yet
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsRDklkijN

American Cornerstone Institute

Right now, the Left is working around the clock to
undermine the Supreme Court...

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osRDklkijN

Fellow
Patriot,

This is
Dr. Ben Carson-I'm writing to you personally because your name is
on my list of Americans who cherish life and want to protect the
unborn. And today I need your help.

I know
you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to
overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement
will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won.

Nothing
could be further from the truth-the fight for life is only just
beginning!

Right
now, the Left is working around the clock to undermine the
Supreme Court's decision while mobilizing millions of pro-choice
democrats and major media outlets to codify abortion-on-demand at
the expense of taxpayers like you.

We cannot
allow the anti-life movement to obscure the fact that a majority
of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that
abortion should be unrestricted.

We must
stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we
don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will
continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to
advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of
the American family.

Today,
I'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe
the sanctity of life is worth defending by adding your name to
the pledge I have linked below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62399706:sRDklkijN:m:3:2532013465:50A01AEA19C7C347256C80C6383B7910:r

By
signing the pledge, you will join a thriving movement of
principled citizens who are uniting to protect the unborn and
refusing to be silenced by a vocal minority of radicalized
fanatics.

I will do
everything in my power to defend every American life and stop the
spread of the Left's anti-life ideology. Will you take a minute
to stand with me by signing this pledge now?

I'd like
to thank you for joining this critical effort. Together, we can
save thousands of lives from abortion over the next year.

Gratefully,
Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder &
Chairman
American
Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: The importance of a dollar.
body:
I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z35vjs6vdaincae4al8feg1vbjvtatl9ggpqehs0_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9im6o72c9h2bs)
---

I am a mom and an accountant, Friend, which means I know how to stretch a dollar.

That's why, on day one, I made sure our team knew that the success of our movement relies on grassroots supporters like YOU. With that, comes a responsibility to make every dollar count and spend your donations wisely.

Unlike other campaigns that are burning through money on private planes, fancy dinners, and country clubs, **we are a lean and mean operation.**

We stretch every dollar as far as it can go and know it's important to spend our money when it counts. But even covering basic expenses to host town halls and travel to battleground states to meet with voters adds up.

**[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znl7cpokb7ir1t70g5r3psp0u6a7lfipa13if56g_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9im6o72c9h2bs "That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win! ")**

Here are just a couple meaningful ways your contribution has helped our team:

**-> TRAVELING:** From day one, I've prioritized meeting with voters, shaking every hand, and amplifying my message everywhere I can. In order to do that, my team and I are flying all over the country, and we're doing it while spending money wisely.

I can tell you firsthand, we're not out here lighting money on fire with private planes and extravagant luxury hotels like some campaigns. We're flying a lot of Spirit and JetBlue. We're getting to New Hampshire, Iowa, and everywhere else we need to go with the most affordable options we can find.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl7qqqbprrkm55tourdgv9ha477dr9stflm5bavo_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9im6o72c9h2bs)
---

**-> EVENTS:** We're running a true grassroots campaign, and that means being on the ground, holding as many grassroots events as possible. Every time we hold a town hall in Iowa, South Carolina, or New Hampshire, it's an opportunity to share my vision, answer questions, and gain the confidence of voters.

But what you may not realize is that all of the costs can quickly add up to rent the event space, chairs, and sound equipment. In order to spend your money wisely, we're holding these events at places like bakeries, local venues, and farms.

---
| | | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvj6u40q9rtbf7csr5vls94c4vn3qls2rg2lj9fo_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9im6o72c9h2bs)
---
| | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zk7inkem867rc0c17stfg6nrh7gq8rufp9ms1c6g_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9im6o72c9h2bs)
---
At the end of the day, this is a tried and true grassroots operation. Our staff is lean and mean and you better believe we're working every hour of the day and spending every dollar wisely. But all of this still costs money, which is why we need your help.

Once the first-in-the-nation caucus is here, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the country begins to cast their ballots.

It's a marathon and we've got to stay on pace to win each and every day. **[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zflnevselajnd27r1e6kjtdqdc92ur88g3qf9dmo_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9im6o72c9h2bs "That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!")**

---
| | [CONTRIBUTE $20.24](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z408tn7s63u85j58lbunm13tu7ddm848oirs9mt8_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9im6o72c9h2bs)
---

**It 's crunch time, Friend!** There's no room for holding back. With just **88 days** left until voting begins every single day matters which is why I appreciate your generous support today when it matters most.
---

My very best,

---

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.
**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zdtas545vgvuhscq32oml3n254k7b29mm18u5nb0_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9im6o72c9h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

subject: Every parent fears hearing these words
body:
It's a call no parent wants: "There's been a mass shooting at your child's school." | | | | | [](https://emilyformichigan.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c160d8287650841171c449cf3&id=253aea3a0b&e=b2327e6d25)
---
|
---
Every parent fears hearing these words:**“There’s been a mass shooting at your child’s school.”**
That’s what I was told on February 14, 2018 when my beloved daughter Jaime was killed in a school shooting in Parkland, Florida. No family should have to hear those words, let alone endure the loss that mine did.
Emily Busch never imagined she would run for office – and then there was a mass shooting at her son’s school in Oxford, Michigan, and he was forced to flee with his friends and teachers to safety. Thankfully, Emily’s son was able to escape, but four others died that day and seven were injured.
**The Republican she’s up against— John James—has accepted nearly a quarter-million dollars from the NRA and Gun Lobby and is blocking any and all gun violence prevention bills. **
Emily knows we deserve better than reps who vote against our families’ best interests because they’re being bankrolled by the NRA, so she decided to run against him. This is as close to a toss-up race as it gets - John James won by just 1600 votes last year - and I know Emily is the one who can win this seat back. [**We need leaders like Emily in Congress who will fight every single day to keep our families safe from gun violence. So I’m asking if you’ll join me in supporting her by donating to her campaign. In a race like this, every dollar and vote could be decisive.**](https://emilyformichigan.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c160d8287650841171c449cf3&id=311a60812e&e=b2327e6d25)
| [DONATE TODAY](https://emilyformichigan.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c160d8287650841171c449cf3&id=790cf8612d&e=b2327e6d25)
---
In the aftermath of the school shooting in Oxford, Michigan and prior to deciding to run for Congress, Emily was an on the ground organizer for gun safety reforms at the state level. She attended Board of Education meetings, testified before the state legislature, and organized discussions and panels with parents to discuss keeping Michigan kids safe from gun violence.
Despite the despair families like mine and so many others have faced as a result of gun violence, I remain hopeful.
**I remain hopeful because everyday people like Emily have transformed their pain into purpose and are dedicated to becoming the change we need to see in our country so that no family has to experience what ours did.**
If Emily wins this highly competitive race, we’ll be one step closer to securing a gun safety majority in Congress and will have replaced an NRA loyalist with an activist mother and professional problem-solver who has pledged to act on gun violence on day one.
[**For all the families who have lost someone to gun violence and for all those families who will soon experience this devastation without life-saving reforms, I’m asking if you’ll join me in electing Emily Busch and a wave of gun violence prevention champions like her at all levels of government.**](https://emilyformichigan.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c160d8287650841171c449cf3&id=d5e5ca6761&e=b2327e6d25)

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3aea6f50abc5ce1a999a3a347b5b9c35ce749f076776c7cdf6cb336505ac8aaf89e4cb6cefc6baefebe602414c6271847ea81585c1bc0f2f94a55d1ddc0b988c

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

# Campaign News and Views
Season's greetings from Ryan and Binkley 2024!

### Happy Fall from Ryan!
The latest Iowa Republican Caucus Voter Survey by Civiqs shows Ryan is **6th in the polls! **He tied with Chris Christie and beat both Mike Pence and Asa Hutchinson! Ryan's message is resonating and gaining momentum with key Iowa voters, just in time for the holiday season! ### MMM Tailgate Speech
Ryan gave a speech at Congresswoman Miller-Meeks' Tailgate last Friday. He talked about America's role as a 'lamppost of freedom' for the rest of the world to follow. [_Watch here_](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=3e2e31473b&e=c1403f41d3)

---
### Bible Talk in Dubuque
Ryan talked with students at Emmaus Bible College about how his Biblical worldview will influence his presidency. Despite the challenges of the primary season, Ryan remains confident in his plans for the nation. [_Read here_](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=1a2d102f4e&e=c1403f41d3)

| |

| | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl8e7f86fsi0pojsh0b7bksr9qctdqfbg2rga880_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9hm0ob2cph2bs)

I am a mom and an accountant, Friend, which means I know how to stretch a dollar.

That's why, on day one, I made sure our team knew that the success of our movement relies on grassroots supporters like YOU. With that, comes a responsibility to make every dollar count and spend your donations wisely.

Unlike other campaigns that are burning through money on private planes, fancy dinners, and country clubs, **we are a lean and mean operation.**

We stretch every dollar as far as it can go and know it's important to spend our money when it counts. But even covering basic expenses to host town halls and travel to battleground states to meet with voters adds up.

**[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6s7jfhrlkv355lqpntb1aci3rsa1pnor40kd03o_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9hm0ob2cph2bs "That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win! ")**

Here are just a couple meaningful ways your contribution has helped our team:

**-> TRAVELING:** From day one, I've prioritized meeting with voters, shaking every hand, and amplifying my message everywhere I can. In order to do that, my team and I are flying all over the country, and we're doing it while spending money wisely.

I can tell you firsthand, we're not out here lighting money on fire with private planes and extravagant luxury hotels like some campaigns. We're flying a lot of Spirit and JetBlue. We're getting to New Hampshire, Iowa, and everywhere else we need to go with the most affordable options we can find.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6hrom4ud9a87opbifvjjs3kohiti0mm9d4nkg7o_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9hm0ob2cph2bs)
---

**-> EVENTS:** We're running a true grassroots campaign, and that means being on the ground, holding as many grassroots events as possible. Every time we hold a town hall in Iowa, South Carolina, or New Hampshire, it's an opportunity to share my vision, answer questions, and gain the confidence of voters.

But what you may not realize is that all of the costs can quickly add up to rent the event space, chairs, and sound equipment. In order to spend your money wisely, we're holding these events at places like bakeries, local venues, and farms.

---
| | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3aa6fmm70o49kbi1k6d6048imr9dehdccsh21h8_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9hm0ob2cph2bs)

At the end of the day, this is a tried and true grassroots operation. Our staff is lean and mean and you better believe we're working every hour of the day and spending every dollar wisely. But all of this still costs money, which is why we need your help.

Once the first-in-the-nation caucus is here, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the country begins to cast their ballots.

It's a marathon and we've got to stay on pace to win each and every day. **[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6iltf4r40br5de258pcuiqui2e7720af2f16hqg_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9hm0ob2cph2bs "That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!")**

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

subject: Who is Mike Johnson, GOP’s new pick to be Speaker?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=747%2E135344%2E7-SVRk)

Friends --
It has been 22 days since we’ve had a Speaker of the House. In just a little bit, House Republicans will nominate Rep. Mike Johnson of Louisiana to serve as the next Speaker -- he is their fourth nominee since McCarthy was ousted 3 weeks ago, and second nominee in just the last 24 hours, after Donald Trump helped tank Tom Emmer’s chances of being Speaker yesterday.
Behind the scenes, Mike Johnson is being described as Jim Jordan without the scandals and attention. He’s every bit as conservative, but has largely flown under the radar in the House. Mike Johnson is Trump’s second choice for Speaker, after Jim Jordan’s failed efforts to take control of the gavel -- which is why he may just succeed in the vote later today.
Johnson’s record gives us a window into what we can expect should he become Speaker: Johnson led efforts to overturn the 2020 election, and joined the efforts to overturn Michigan’s 2020 Presidential results -- siding decidedly with Donald Trump over Michigan voters. He voted against legislation supporting gay marriage, twice. He voted against the PACT Act, bipartisan legislation to expand health care and benefits for veterans exposed to burn pits and toxic substances.
But above all that, Mike Johnson has been a lead champion for a national abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or common miscarriage — even as more moderate republicans have tried to edge away from their lifelong support for bans in the face of the new political consequences. Johnson, who has his own podcast, has continued to be a vehement believer in a nationwide abortion ban, and has stated publicly that he supports *imprisoning women* for getting an abortion.
As the Republican Party continues down a path of extremism — and prepares for another year of extreme, culture-war legislation more extreme than what Kevin McCarthy put forward to the floor -- it’s never been more clear that Democrats need to take back the House and maintain control of the White House and Senate. [**The only way that happens is by electing principled leaders like Elissa who will push back against extremism in Washington. Will you join us in that effort by chipping in $3 today?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231025-1-15&t=2&akid=747%2E135344%2E7-SVRk)**

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72153315/434473069/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTY0MTUyNjAtNGI3My1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9Yi09IsVfFTjnwtyTNpSYMQMa8bAHEf3Ic2eE1CzhCs=&emci=d948144a-a772-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=56415260-4b73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Between April and September, the top five U.S. newspapers by circulation — including _The New York Times, the Los Angeles Times, and The Washington Post_ — published **378 articles** referencing President Biden’s or Donald Trump’s ages.
Of these 378 articles, 88 percent mentioned Biden’s age while _just_ 42 percent mentioned Trump’s — **despite the fact the two men are less than three years apart.**
We’ll explain more about why this blatant hypocrisy is happening in just a moment, but if you’re ready to support factual, local journalism free from the toxic “both sides” dynamic that has dominated so much of the 2024 Presidential election coverage, **[please chip in anything you can afford today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72153318/434473071/641188572?refcode=em20231025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTY0MTUyNjAtNGI3My1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9Yi09IsVfFTjnwtyTNpSYMQMa8bAHEf3Ic2eE1CzhCs=)**
President Biden’s age has been THE central talking point for Donald Trump, Fox News, and the rest of the right-wing media since the 2020 election. Famously, Trump called Biden “sleepy Joe” in a childish attempt to smear Biden with a negative label like he did in 2016 when he baselessly called Hillary Clinton “crooked.”
Unsurprisingly, Fox News, Newsmax, and others on the right have continued to amplify Trump’s attacks on Biden’s age. Today, misinformation, deep fake videos, and bogus medical claims about Biden’s fitness for office are thriving online and offline.
**The study showing hypocritical coverage of Biden by the mainstream media shows just how pervasive the right-wing attacks on Biden’s age have become.**
Peter, Donald Trump, and the right-wing media are masterful at manipulating the mainstream media. They understand that if a lie gets repeated long enough, a group will always believe it's true. And when that happens, they know the mainstream media will help spread the lie in the name of providing "balance" and "both sides" coverage.
At Courier, our model is entirely different. We provide factual information about the issues that matter the most to the communities served by our newsrooms. We will never compromise our values in the name of so-called “balance” or telling “both sides” of a story.
**At Courier, we don’t believe in so-called “alternative facts.” Lies are lies, and the truth is the truth, period.**
Unlike the mainstream media, we keep our reporting accessible to all without locking it behind a paywall or subscription fee. Because of the generosity of grassroots supporters like you, we can fight back and stop the spread of right-wing misinformation campaigns at their source.

subject: I am writing to ask you to contribute $25 to JoeBiden’s campaign today.

body:
I never underestimate my opponents, but I don't overestimate them either. | | |
---
Peter, I never underestimate my opponents, but I don’t overestimate them either. Whether Joe Biden faces Donald Trump or any of the other extreme MAGA Republicans running for president, I know Democrats have what it takes to win. clean_body: I never underestimate my opponents, but I don't overestimate them either. | | | Peter, I never underestimate my opponents, but I don’t overestimate them either. Whether Joe Biden faces Donald Trump or any of the other extreme MAGA Republicans running for president, I know Democrats have what it takes to win. We have what it takes to win because, as I like to say, the beauty of the Democratic Party is in the mix. It’s in people from all backgrounds, upbringings, and communities coming together for a better future. Our diversity is our strength -- our unity is our power! Each of us has a role to play in making sure that this disgraced and defeated former occasional occupant of the White House never crosses its threshold again. Nothing less than our Democracy is at stake in this election. Trump is about one person: himself. Democrats are in this together -- and working together is how we’ll win this race and reelect Team Biden-Harris to continue delivering For The People. So please: What do people want in a president? They want wisdom, judgment, values, knowledge, and a connection to the American people -- that is our great President Joe Biden! Under the President’s magnificent leadership, Democrats have made a tangible difference in the lives of America’s families. It was an honor to work alongside him as Speaker of the House for the first two years of the Biden-Harris term to deliver For The People. Now, we must be prepared to finish the job of building a stronger and fairer future for America’s families. But we can only do that as individuals coming together for a purpose greater than ourselves. So know your power and have confidence in what you have to contribute. name: Shift WA
subject: State income tax updates
body:
In recent years, we've kept you updated on the attempts by Washington Democrats to impose a state income tax, an issue that strikes at our state's very constitution. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401079:W4PP2ki4N:m:1:2610672541:AEB6F53D3E7BDDEDF1396405DB18FDDB:r "Shift Washington")
---
|
Friends, We here at Shift WA are dedicated to keeping you informed about the issues that truly matter to people across our state. Our mission is to ensure that you are well-equipped with the latest news and updates, so you can make informed decisions and take action to shift the direction of our state. In recent years, we've kept you updated on the attempts by Washington Democrats to impose a state income tax, an issue that strikes at our state's very constitution. Despite voters rejecting such a tax multiple times at the ballot, we've unfortunately seen our state Supreme Court redefine the simple meaning of "income" to justify a state income tax on capital gains, a faulty decision which is being pushed to the attention of the U.S. Supreme Court. It certainly got the attention of the Wall Street Journal, which noted a legal brief filed with the court by the Washington Policy Center (just a couple weeks after we here at Shift WA shared it with our readers). As our readers know, Governor Jay Inslee played a significant role in the passage of a state income tax, starting with capital gains. Inslee and his fellow Democrats' attempts to claim the tax is an excise tax prompted the Journal to comment, "creativity and lawmaking rarely go together well, and sometimes they run up against the Constitution." The U.S. Supreme Court is currently evaluating the merits of whether "interstate excise taxes 'threatens to wreak havoc on taxpayers and businesses around the country,' as the Washington Policy Center highlighted in an amicus brief" to the court. Our commitment to providing you with insightful information is highlighted in the fact that the Journal could have just been reading Shift to find that quote, as we informed readers like you before any mainstream news outlets. **_[Your contribution today will ensure that we can continue our vital work, keeping you informed about state politics.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401080:W4PP2ki4N:m:1:2610672541:AEB6F53D3E7BDDEDF1396405DB18FDDB:r)_** **_[Please consider contributing $100, $50, or even $25 today, so we can continue keeping you up-to-date on the latest news coming out of our state.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401080:W4PP2ki4N:m:1:2610672541:AEB6F53D3E7BDDEDF1396405DB18FDDB:r)_** With your support, we can keep a watchful eye on developments like the state income tax issue and ensure that you are up-to-date as well. Thank you, The Shift Team P.S. Your contribution today will have a direct impact on our ability to keep you informed and empowered. **_[Please donate now to help us in our mission to protect our state.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401080:W4PP2ki4N:m:1:2610672541:AEB6F53D3E7BDDEDF1396405DB18FDDB:r)_** | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401081:W4PP2ki4N:m:1:2610672541:AEB6F53D3E7BDDEDF1396405DB18FDDB:r)

subject: Let me get into the weeds for a quick minute
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
Everyone will be watching the election on November 7th to see if the far-right will make more gains or if supporters of democracy will stop them in their tracks.

Friends -
I’m sure you’ve heard the talking heads call Virginia a “bellwether state” before. But is it really true? Let me get into the weeds for a quick minute:
In 2017, Democratic victories in the Virginia suburbs predicted the huge backlash against Trump’s hate and authoritarianism that we saw in the 2018 midterms, when Democrats took the House and made Nancy Pelosi Speaker once again.
In 2019, Democrats beat the GOP and won a trifecta in Virginia’s state elections, and the next year Biden beat Trump, flipped states like Arizona and Georgia blue, and helped Democrats win control of Congress along the way.

At Freedom Virginia our main focus is making life more affordable for everyday Virginians. In 2023, we worked hard on legislation to establish a Prescription Drug Affordability Board (PDAB), which was eventually killed by Governor Youngkin and House Republicans.

Joseph is now 18 years old, is a senior in High School, and ready to vote this November. Hooyah! | John Fredericks TV Interview | == | This morning John Fredericks and I talked about the elections, our 2nd amendment, and more. == | My First Letter to the Editor Made the Front Page | | How many of you are sick and tired of the Republican infighting? My first Letter to the Editor made the front page. I would have never written a letter like this, but, we have a few anti-Trump Republicans helping Democrats by attacking fellow Republicans in the middle of a General Election via the paper, Facebook, etc. Right now everything we care about is at stake on November 7. This divisive behavior is inexcusable. The good news is the majority of Republicans across Virginia are being adults, working together, and putting any petty differences aside so we can win this November! == | Finally We have a Speaker | == | "...the first bill I'm gonna bring to this floor, in just a little while, will be in support of our dear friend Israel and we're overdue in getting that done."
