Keep your foot on the gas so we can win in November! | Beaverdam Baptist Pastor Gary Stewart Retires | | | | | | My friend and fellow veteran Dr. Gary Stewart, who served in the Marine Corps, retired this weekend as head Pastor of Beaverdam Baptist Church in Hanover County. It amazes me how many lives Gary, his wife Amy, and many other members of the church have impacted all over the world. Governor Glenn Youngkin made a surprise video appearance during the service thanking Gary for his service to our community. Thank you Gary and Amy for leading us to Jesus. God bless you! | Rassawek 2023 | | | | | | | | | | | | | Thousands of people from all over Virginia attended Rassawek this weekend in Goochland County. I really enjoyed talking with constituents, checking out tractors, old cars, and more. Learn more about == | Goochland Tea Party | | | | | | | The Goochland Tea Party is working hard to get qualified Republicans elected this November. Stop by the Goochland Tea Party tent each Saturday 10am to 3:30pm at 30 Broad Street Road, Manakin Sabot, VA, 23103 next to the Food Lion in Centerville each Saturday from now to November 7. Stop by and learn about local politics, meet local candidates, get yard signs, Trump gear, McGuire gear, and sign the petition to get Trump on the ballot! | More Patriotism | == | Though not perfect, we have come a long way as a people and our country has an amazing history. We must teach our children the importance of patriotism. Like Reagan said you take our problems times 15 and we still have the best country ever! | Cumberland County Small Business | | While campaigning in Cumberland County, I ran across this Food Truck Three Roosters Brick Oven Pizza. == | Heavenly Glory Goochland | | While campaigning all over the district, I remind folks don't forget to look around and enjoy all the heavenly glory like this rainbow after the rain! | Please consider supporting Governor Youngkin's effort to "==". body:
Mine experienced it firsthand.
#
Peter,
Every family living paycheck-to-paycheck in our country shares this fear: **_Something_ happens, and you lose everything.**
For my family, that fear became a reality when my little sister was born with a heart condition that required surgeries at a hospital over 100 miles away from home. Maxed out credit cards and no money left, my parents went bankrupt.
We relied on the generosity of our community to make it through that time. Friends, neighbors, members of our church — everyday people who had no more than we did, taking care of each other when times got tough.
**That’s something Josh Hawley could never understand.**
I’m running for U.S. Senate because no working family should live in fear. I know what that’s like — and I’m ready to fight like hell to make sure families like the ones in my old community have the resources they need to build strong, healthy, and secure lives all across our state. But I can’t do it without your help, Peter:
**[So if you’re with me, will you please consider adding a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford to my grassroots campaign today? name: Nikki Haley
subject: The importance of a dollar.
body:
I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq1i6khdf5lfbulmc2mrli7bfbvauqhh0orb2tro_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9hmao74chh2bs)
---

I am a mom and an accountant, Friend, which means I know how to stretch a dollar.

That's why, on day one, I made sure our team knew that the success of our movement relies on grassroots supporters like YOU. With that, comes a responsibility to make every dollar count and spend your donations wisely.

Unlike other campaigns that are burning through money on private planes, fancy dinners, and country clubs, **we are a lean and mean operation.**

We stretch every dollar as far as it can go and know it's important to spend our money when it counts. But even covering basic expenses to host town halls and travel to battleground states to meet with voters adds up.

**[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqpc3r7fvt7cr4m0li88hvumd2oenl4hvufujoj0_rp22sh2s8i66p70s9hmao74chh2bs "That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $20.24 today to help fund my grassroots efforts so we can get my message out and win! ")**

Here are just a couple meaningful ways your contribution has helped our team:

**-> TRAVELING:** From day one, I've prioritized meeting with voters, shaking every hand, and amplifying my message everywhere I can. In order to do that, my team and I are flying all over the country, and we're doing it while spending money wisely.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

I’m Kevin Lincoln, the conservative Republican who is running to defeat leftist Josh Harder in California’s highly-targeted 9th Congressional District – _one of the most competitive House races in the country._

**I’m a Marine Corps veteran, mayor of my hometown of Stockton, a proud father & husband, and I’m running to rescue American families and workers from Washington D.C.’s broken politics.**

[ ** Send a Marine & Mayor to Congress ➞ **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=56a4b0d1c0804c3296d5edb61a1152bd&_e=mymcRsTlyYp3YHMUQ3mGbB-8Ksexe3kw4G1cWq2tO5ML3bpVPfDIN87hudRU56bRC3TqAxMh4IbNi0OwW2aJYEIM8-3II09ueKkmZWvzHie6NjkJjkuiLmME56WaeZF16_GJLHK03u_JOv4vXcGK1WtLOkdhhLAtI236aOiqGvzZzAey38zK_7_H8dT56raJ34QmU6LgzgsJMZRWUeQSu8X6FJNbQ_qjr3AV156KkN8zWtf4433pHOomnPlD1Yx-BAyWQCbTowIPpI2Zkl7y1ivCUCwT3kF4hHKYQ-nCDxg2SOVzqduilvfOfi9N7J1j_1QHiIlZtUbbctFZOYktzt6OSy_imm0RCS6z1V99WleV25c5jjy7e4-bEEDkMBCCZxDTpjgNYQJL0tLbIZo0Fg%3D%3D)
Service has always defined my life. I joined the United States Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer.

After 9/11, I was assigned to Marine One to serve and protect the President of the United States.

When I completed my military service, I graduated from college while working full time and raising a family. But my urge to serve hadn’t gone. I continued to serve my community as a pastor and as a non-profit leader.

**Now, one of the greatest honors of my life is being able to serve as the Mayor of my hometown of Stockton, California.**

As Mayor, my team and I have revitalized our local economy, attracted businesses that have created jobs, balanced our budget, tackled homelessness, and reduced violent crime.

America as a whole is suffering these same problems, but the politicians in the White House and Congress don’t have what it takes to fix them.

**I do, and that’s why I’m running for Congress. My country needs me again, and I’m ready to serve.**

We need to get inflation under control, revive our economy, reprioritize public safety, support our veterans, and make the politicians in Washington D.C. work for and serve the American people once again.

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

A law firm representing the WAGOP delivered litigation hold notices to the King County Elections department, the King County Prosecutor’s office... | | | [ ](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=795c7e540d&e=6a281f566d)
---
| |
---
| **WAGOP delivers litigation hold notices to King County Elections, King County Prosecutor's Office, and others involved in election administration in WA**
On Monday, October 23, 2023, a law firm representing the WAGOP delivered litigation hold notices to the King County Elections department, the King County Prosecutor’s office and other public agencies involved in election administration in Washington. The litigation hold notices apply to correspondence and other materials related to specific activities of King County Elections during the recent state primary election that took place in August 2023.

During the ballot counting process of that primary, King County Elections replaced certain computer hardware systems in a manner that appears to violate sections of both state statute and administrative code.
---
| [Contribute to our Legal Fund in King County >>>>](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=b392e33010&e=6a281f566d "Contribute to our Legal Fund in King County >>>>")
---
| “In light of the apparent decision of Secretary of State Hobbs to disregard these admitted violations of law (a decision we only infer by his refusal to respond to correspondence regarding the matter), WAGOP is evaluating all options, including the prospect of litigation to compel King County Elections to cease its violations of law and comply with all elections related laws in the future.”

Specific materials that the notice demands elections officials preserve include:
* All emails and voicemails between any employee or representative of King County Elections and any person related to any aspect of the conduct of the 2023 primary election.
* All tabulation equipment, including all servers and backup servers (or primary and secondary servers, or servers denominated any other way); server software and any flash drives of data of any sort from the servers; any manufacturers’ manual for tabulation servers; backups and operating manuals for any other network servers used at King County Elections.
* All records of any sort regarding any software or hardware updates performed on any election-related systems including at a minimum records showing the date and time of the update, who performed the update, who was present, what specifically was updated, the procedures followed, and the results of the update; all records of any sort concerning any testing performed, and the results of the tests.
* All correspondence with the ballot printer.
* All records showing the manufacturer make and serial number for all computers of any type or nature on which King County Elections employed election management software for the conduct of the 2023 primary election, including for purposes such as to create ballot layouts, create an election, export an election to any external drive, or to generate Cast Vote Records reports.
* All signature envelopes from the 2023 primary election; all ballots; all signature verification equipment and software used to check the ballot envelopes; all versions of the list of challenged ballots and matchback reports; all scanning and adjudication equipment and software; all Cast Vote Records.
* All daily tabulation records, certification documents and related reports, including the confidence reports and any reports showing adjudication and resolution of changes.
* All lists or records of all election office staff and vendor employees who worked during any part of the 2023 primary election; all lists or records reflecting the presence and names of election observers.
* All pass key records or other entry/exit monitoring of the election facility during the 2023 primary election; all cameras and maintenance logs comprising any kind of recording or record, for whatever purpose created, showing the facilities during the 2023 primary elections.
* All correspondence between any employee or officer of the office of the Washington Secretary of State and any employee, officer, vendor, or other representative of King County Elections from May 1st, 2023.

After the litigation hold notice was delivered, WAGOP Chairman Jim Walsh issued the following statement:

“On behalf of all Washington voters, WAGOP is taking action to assure free and fair elections in our state. We must restore the people’s confidence and trust in our state’s elections. King County Elections has admitted it ‘swapped’ election-related computer hardware in a way that does not comply with state law and administrative code. That county agency now insists that the ‘swap’ had no effect on the primary election results. Whether that statement is true remains undetermined—and beside the point.

“Elections officials in Washington need to follow the law. They need to be transparent and accountable for their actions. Holding county elections officials accountable is the Secretary of State’s responsibility. WAGOP asked the current WA Secretary of State to do so, in this case, in a letter dated September 29, 2023. He has not responded to our request. So, we may have to do his job for him.

“Washington Republicans are committed to making sure that every legal Washington voter’s vote counts. That ballots are counted fairly, legally and transparently. We’re not going to tolerate slipshod practices anymore. No more bins of ballots found after election day. No more dead people or people living in other states voting. This state’s elections must be clean. They will be clean. And WAGOP will do everything necessary to make sure that they are clean.”
**_[Click here for the litigation hold notice that explains the context of its demands.](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=b22e9f1b84&e=6a281f566d)_**

subject: I say... NAY!
body:
what's this even mean? |
---
| | Check this out...

Let's clear up a common misconception about voting "No" on a budget bill.

A lot of folks think that if you vote against a budget, you're against the organization it funds.

That's not always true!

When you vote "No," you're basically saying, "This budget needs some fine-tuning." It's like sending your steak back to the kitchen because it's not cooked right—not because you hate the place.

_In Idaho's big-spending culture, it's more important than ever to keep an eye on liberal spending habits._

When a budget bill seems packed with unnecessary expenditures, outpaces inflation, or unnecessarily grows government, voting "No" means you want to send it back to the Finance Committee to get reworked.

This means we need to keep an eye on the folks who vote "Yes" on every single budget bill without question! It's like agreeing to eat whatever the chef throws on your plate without even tasting it. You're basically giving a free pass to waste, bloat, and inefficiency.

So, when a conservative votes "No," we're not against schools, roads, or public safety.

Most of the time, we're saying, "Let's get this right. Let's make sure every dollar counts."

**__Because that's what actual conservatives DO_._**

Cheers,

Brian

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. | I’m running to bring those values of hard work, determination, and results to the U.S. Senate, but I’ll need your help to get it done. Our election is on March 5. Will you help us reach the finish line by pitching in $3 today?
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4297%2E5257348%2EFVFX-X)
Here’s something you might not know about me, Derek: I’m a triathlete.
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20231025_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4297%2E5257348%2EFVFX-X)
Now, let me tell you the backstory.
As members of Congress, we work to make sure our government accurately represents the millions of Americans who elected us. At the bare minimum, that includes making sure our government pays its bills on time and passes critical legislation. (Both seem harder than ever these days...)
Like most jobs, this carries a lot of stress. Everyone has a different way of relieving that stress.
For me, that was running.
Before my knees started bothering me, I used to run a fair amount — a carryover from playing soccer as a kid. I started cycling, and cross-training really helped.
Around that time, my chief of staff asked if I had any interest in doing a triathlon. I said yes.
**A triathlon consists of three parts: Typically swimming, cycling, and long-distance running.** In many ways, pushing myself to complete that first triathlon made me into a better, more effective representative.
* **It taught me to work through chaos**. During the swimming portion, I had to do my best to work through hundreds of people trying to swim over and around me at all times. That’s also an accurate description of what working in the House under a Republican majority feels like.

* **It taught me to break up a big problem into smaller pieces**. Instead of thinking through the total miles I’d have to swim, bike, and run, I broke it up into smaller chunks. As long as I made it past this first mile, I could do another one. And another. And another. That’s how I’ve tackled many of the pressing issues in Congress, too — one step at a time.

* **And it taught me that anything was possible with a bit of effort**. Like leading an impeachment process or investigating the attack on January 6, a triathlon is daunting — but not impossible. All of these can be accomplished with the right mindset.

I enjoyed that first triathlon enough to do several more after that. I’ve even biked 550 miles down the middle of California with AIDS/LifeCycle. And while it’s gotten even more difficult in the last several years to train, I still take all of those lessons with me.

subject: Join the fight to protect the unborn
body:
This is Dr. Ben Carson--I'm writing to you personally because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish life and want to protect the unborn.

|
---
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=84d6f814ce43411697b5664f462fce98&_e=oitnnnyHcR028i-zvss6lnS6g-jfkSSc3FsUe6CbDq_nGsTyahNVqj93vGnS9vO88eG8TK0V9zELi4a0xbMS-2E3f73wGjLbzet5TaKO9qOHO6R7_32KR6m4v4BUxVhC9r3xniKfTyztF9DMN-XOpNqD2EeoOj6h_6YZImVcgMfgBW4fLLtzkwESMjAAJ4oUvfyPQSF6JZpk6_RKK6kiA19ogv0kJpunUZ6cCLeHFCp16C2fPX4Kxx541nZkv8nVcLQYYkGKlsJ5SSf1-DBZagCDPyWTiKA281TTyrwqbVnZJPhkKfFnhN_Ny6VmV_rdjg6NnLzbCsbFiPeME1hkzaHzUP7b0-nrpuJgsMEBWVsVAvX6VuhWEPBKbNd4agiUl78i415hVFp7exuYVw7qeojZ4vXpu-bcYJ1Fdfr83L8%3D)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

This is Dr. Ben Carson--I'm writing to you personally because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish life and want to protect the unborn. **And today I need your help.**

I know you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won. [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=84d6f814ce43411697b5664f462fce98&_e=oitnnnyHcR028i-zvss6lnS6g-jfkSSc3FsUe6CbDq_nGsTyahNVqj93vGnS9vO88eG8TK0V9zELi4a0xbMS-2E3f73wGjLbzet5TaKO9qOHO6R7_32KR6m4v4BUxVhC9r3xniKfTyztF9DMN-XOpNqD2EeoOj6h_6YZImVcgMfgBW4fLLtzkwESMjAAJ4oUvfyPQSF6JZpk6_RKK6kiA19ogv0kJpunUZ6cCLeHFCp16C2fPX4Kxx541nZkv8nVcLQYYkGKlsJ5SSf1-DBZatWiRF3NlA09XdDtrFr46KeaaZlOyvUEG5bScfdl0lDmwTVN_vjLwSFOIR-KCutSLvff8UeU_787RP4Mf-D80YtXlKalQPLRteB8c-oeg4nIfmNKR6-aPVJYscxZWKbuXr3O8wq0fx074U4bhjlVGnI%3D) **Nothing could be further from the truth --**
[the fight for life is only just beginning!](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=84d6f814ce43411697b5664f462fce98&_e=oitnnnyHcR028i-zvss6lnS6g-jfkSSc3FsUe6CbDq_nGsTyahNVqj93vGnS9vO88eG8TK0V9zELi4a0xbMS-2E3f73wGjLbzet5TaKO9qOHO6R7_32KR6m4v4BUxVhC9r3xniKfTyztF9DMN-XOpNqD2EeoOj6h_6YZImVcgMfgBW4fLLtzkwESMjAAJ4oUvfyPQSF6JZpk6_RKK6kiA19ogv0kJpunUZ6cCLeHFCp16C2fPX4Kxx541nZkv8nVcLQYYkGKlsJ5SSf1-DBZarBHZim4Ps5zp-kuFc21XYQ0QxpntpShJBhPnVc4M4y7rYs-W7bsMaoZQCkkPyQu0owFQKDD6pCuMWO3jBddn3x-6ScFiRVSTLmBw_1MoD_9Hcv9J4fmOXWvWjKyVyH_fdqBXNZFZ6kcExWHfBQYsLc%3D)

Right now, the Left is working around the clock to undermine the Supreme Court's decision while mobilizing millions of pro-choice democrats and major media outlets to codify abortion-on-demand at the expense of taxpayers like you.

**We cannot allow the anti-life movement to obscure the fact that a majority of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that abortion should be unrestricted.**

We must stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of the American family.

**Today, I 'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe the sanctity of life is worth defending by adding your name to the pledge I have linked below:**

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=84d6f814ce43411697b5664f462fce98&_e=oitnnnyHcR028i-zvss6lnS6g-jfkSSc3FsUe6CbDq_nGsTyahNVqj93vGnS9vO88eG8TK0V9zELi4a0xbMS-2E3f73wGjLbzet5TaKO9qOHO6R7_32KR6m4v4BUxVhC9r3xniKfTyztF9DMN-XOpNqD2EeoOj6h_6YZImVcgMfgBW4fLLtzkwESMjAAJ4oUvfyPQSF6JZpk6_RKK6kiA19ogv0kJpunUZ6cCLeHFCp16C2fPX4Kxx541nZkv8nVcLQYYkGKlsJ5SSf1-DBZaoGsIfRUIGz8YI1S9b39xe0DX82HCo_W1Rf8N7vuNlEgTrIa_g7Qycbe4eN5O55WSbgcEizs11Uq71lV6XDcjclLPE1PipRgYS5Iy_ktBL1EZu8fu1TybBdVcpYF0HE4rMzJzm-KyS8B2RBcs9YNx9U%3D)

By signing the pledge, you will join a thriving movement of principled citizens who are uniting to protect the unborn and refusing to be silenced by a vocal minority of radicalized fanatics.

I will do everything in my power to defend every American life and stop the spread of the Left's anti-life ideology.
[**Will you take a minute to stand with me by signing this pledge now?**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=84d6f814ce43411697b5664f462fce98&_e=oitnnnyHcR028i-zvss6lnS6g-jfkSSc3FsUe6CbDq_nGsTyahNVqj93vGnS9vO88eG8TK0V9zELi4a0xbMS-2E3f73wGjLbzet5TaKO9qOHO6R7_32KR6m4v4BUxVhC9r3xniKfTyztF9DMN-XOpNqD2EeoOj6h_6YZImVcgMfgBW4fLLtzkwESMjAAJ4oUvfyPQSF6JZpk6_RKK6kiA19ogv0kJpunUZ6cCLeHFCp16C2fPX4Kxx541nZkv8nVcLQYYkGKlsJ5SSf1-DBZarcu8MF33itVxI4qtW7gk_SqsLXvRsoOoj_8ixea6xYnXvzTbBSlm9T1YJRXhV9g6Sq3lkT2C4o9zFb8L72yLVrz9oCLHezUA3pQRm7jRMoSwBgYOhHf7WGW2IOlCxGw363ymcWrZ-ZpY9I0MiXnLqQ%3D)

I'd like to thank you for joining this critical effort. Together, we can save thousands of lives from abortion over the next year.

Gratefully,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

clean_body: She just voted to make a far-right Trump ally Speaker of the House. | | | | Peter – Republicans have finally elected a new Speaker. After more than three weeks of embarrassing chaos, they went with Mike Johnson. If that's not a name you're familiar with, you're far from alone — he was unknown to most of America before this week. Well... = Mike Johnson is best known for organizing Congressional Republicans' demand that the Supreme Court overturn the 2020 election. He was a cheerleader for the chorus of lies that would culminate in the attack on the Capitol on January 6, 2021. The New York Times even described him as "the most important architect" of the Electoral College objections that day. And Lori Chavez-DeRemer voted for Mike Johnson. She has chosen to side with one of the biggest election deniers on the far right. That is not what the people of OR-05 expect or want out of their representative. = = It's not just Mike Johnson's election denialism that makes him too extreme. He's also indicated he wants to cut Social Security and Medicare. He authored a federal version of the "Don't Say Gay" bill that we've seen attack students and teachers at the state level. **Dear Friend** ,
As you may have seen, Nick LaLota and his Republican colleagues have finally elected a new Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson. Of course, they have gone in an even more extreme direction, if that was possible. Here are some facts about the new Speaker that LaLota just voted for:
* He [led the charge](https://gaughran2020.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da1ef5330c259be898aff5d12&id=367e11eae6&e=a6aa651d40) on a lawsuit to overturn the election results in multiple states in 2020. The Supreme Court dismissed his suit out of hand.
* According to the Washington Post, “He has led efforts to protect people who discriminate against LGBTQ people and backs strict restrictions on abortion.”
* Johnson spearheaded budgets resolutions that called for ~$2 trillion in cuts to Medicare, $3 trillion in cuts to Medicaid+ACA, & ~$750 billion in cuts to Social Security.

We shouldn’t be surprised LaLota supports Johnson, since LaLota has made his own radical positions more and more clear in his short time in office: backing an absurd impeachment of Joe Biden, voting for multiple anti-abortion measures, and supporting a corrupt rule change that would gut the Office of Congressional Ethics.

I'm running to eject extremists like Nick LaLota from Congress.[ Can you chip in to my campaign?](https://gaughran2020.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da1ef5330c259be898aff5d12&id=549c9e4881&e=a6aa651d40)

Long Island deserves a dedicated Member of Congress with a proven track record. As a former State Senator, County Legislator, Suffolk County Water Chair, and Huntington Town Board Member, I've consistently advocated for our communities and plan to bring the same dedication to the House of Representatives.

In the Senate, I codified Roe v. Wade, enacted crucial gun safety laws, and secured millions for our schools. In Congress, I'll reinstate SALT deductions, safeguard Long Island's environment, and champion national reproductive rights and gun safety measures.

[If you’re with me, please send a donation so I’m in the strongest possible position to win.](https://gaughran2020.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da1ef5330c259be898aff5d12&id=f3a8632c8c&e=a6aa651d40)

Jim

records from the Massachusetts State Police that indicate the presence
of Barack Obama for a witness interview in the death investigation of
the Obamas’ personal chef Tafari Campbell.

records from the Massachusetts State Police that indicate the presence
of Barack Obama for a witness interview in the death investigation of
the Obamas’ personal chef Tafari Campbell. The records, which are
heavily redacted, indicate Barack Obama arrived at the emergency
response scene via motorcade. A short time later, a cold, wet woman,
who was a witness, arrived.

body:
This month, we are proud to honor Bill Morris. | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
# Welcome to the October edition of **The Moran Minuteman**.
This monthly newsletter is our way of recognizing extraordinary efforts in Texas Congressional District 1 and providing an inside look into what happens behind the scenes in the life of a Congressman.
---
|
---
| This month, I am especially thankful for East Texans. With all the turmoil in the world and Washington, D.C., I am grateful to return to the solid foundation of faith, family, and freedom that is alive and well in the First District of Texas.

Many people have reached out over the last few weeks as Congress has been engaged in a chaotic environment that is all too often driven by personal ambition instead of good, sound, conservative policymaking. You have let me know you are praying for me, our nation, and Israel. Know that I feel your prayers and that serving as your Congressman is the honor of a lifetime.
---
|
---
|
## Congratulations to our October Minuteman -
When I think of East Texans, I think of the [Minutemen of the Revolutionary War](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=b50e4c413c&e=bbce4dd6ad). Loyal to country and community, dependable, selfless, and ready at a moment's notice, the Minutemen were American heroes who helped turn the tide of the Revolutionary War. **Today's East Texans reflect those traits.** You are patriotic, dependable, and deeply committed to making our communities better.

Each month, I will recognize an East Texan who has gone above and beyond in serving our region - someone who epitomizes the identity of a Minuteman. In addition to recognition in the monthly newsletter, we will send the person a Moran Minuteman t-shirt.

This month's Minuteman, Bill Morris, is the Panola County Veterans Service Officer, but his work goes far beyond his job at the county office. An Army veteran, Bill started the Panola County Veterans Relief Fund for all veterans in Panola County. This fund has helped replace roofs, keep on the utilities, and provide food, transportation, and a myriad of other needed services for veterans.

Additionally, Bill hosts a Freedom Celebration every 4th of July weekend, including a clay shoot, to benefit veterans. Bill is the curator of the Military Museum in Carthage, where he has worked diligently to add more pieces to it. He gives free tours to anyone, but he especially enjoys providing tours to schoolchildren so he can educate them on the sacrifices made by members of the armed forces.
---
|
---
| Thank you, Bill, for your dedication to our community, state, and nation. It is an honor to recognize you as the October 2023 Minuteman.

Do you know an East Texan who would be a great next recipient? Please submit their name **[here](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=02beadc145&e=bbce4dd6ad).**

Our Moran Minuteman team will also be out and about serving at community events and in disaster relief efforts. Look for us, and we’ll toss you a t-shirt!
---
| [Nominate a Minuteman!](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=400302020a&e=bbce4dd6ad "Nominate a Minuteman!")
---
|
---
|
## Delivering on Promises
When I ran for Congress, I recognized the unique, strong bond that America shares with Israel and promised to do my part to strengthen our partnership and make known our unwavering support for Israel's right to defend itself. Following the deadly Hamas attack against Israel, I [wrote an op-ed](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=5f190c3133&e=bbce4dd6ad) for the Dallas Morning News. In it, I stated, "We must stand firmly with Israel, sharing intelligence and resources, providing military equipment and support to the Israeli army, or using our military muscle directly against those responsible."

I am continuing to pray for Israel and its people and am doing everything in my power as the Congressman from the First District of Texas and as a member of the Foreign Affairs Committee to ensure that Israel is equipped to respond to these heinous attacks.
---
| Sincerely,
---
|
---
| Nathaniel Moran Congressman, First District of Texas

Scott Perry, Donald Trump, and company continue to normalize political violence as they assault our Democracy:
* During Trump’s administration, death threats against members of Congress doubled from 4,800 to 9,600, according to U.S. Capitol Police. Perry did not object.

* Over a ten-year period, 96% of extremist killings were committed by people motivated by right-wing ideologies, according to the Anti-Defamation League. Perry does not object.

* Trump’s Jan 6th Insurrection – another “day that will live in infamy” – caused deaths and police officer injuries. Perry has neither condemned the violence nor answered investigators’ questions.

* Trump recently suggested that General (R) Mark Milley deserves execution for Trump’s false claim that Milley committed treason. Perry did not object.

[This is Perry, Trump, and their fellow extremists at their worst. With you help, we can vote out extremists like Perry next year and give PA-10 real representation in Congress – please pitch in right away.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72171578/434525920/226345580?amount=10&source=RC_EM_FR_WL_231025_1_1&refcode2=184121ff-6e73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&contactdata=6oZ9bjfmJmJTDbuTT/2ESp1TW43XKfhFi1gRqdyzAYj/5X1q+b7oXljRZzlNnwNV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxODQxMjFmZi02ZTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mtbaLYl_RNY7gzfMiJVpH3Ya-N79pzFn0-IuSMpNBGA=) | | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72171579/434525921/226345580?amount=10&source=RC_EM_FR_WL_231025_1_1&refcode2=184121ff-6e73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&contactdata=6oZ9bjfmJmJTDbuTT/2ESp1TW43XKfhFi1gRqdyzAYj/5X1q+b7oXljRZzlNnwNV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxODQxMjFmZi02ZTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mtbaLYl_RNY7gzfMiJVpH3Ya-N79pzFn0-IuSMpNBGA=)
---
So, last week when there was a spike in death threats against members of Congress who opposed election denier and all-around awful human being Jim Jordan for Speaker, it was not surprising that Perry said, _**“All of us in Congress receive death threats. I don’t know if that’s a news flash for anybody here. There are people out in the world that dislike us and threaten us, that’s nothing new. It’s nothing new to any member of Congress. Another red herring.”**_

While saying that the threats “should be taken seriously,” Perry conspicuously did not condemn them and those who made them.

[I will stand up to political violence against anyone. Please stand up for me in my campaign to defeat Scott Perry, and donate any amount to ensure we have what it takes to win.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72171581/434525923/226345580?amount=10&source=RC_EM_FR_WL_231025_1_1&refcode2=184121ff-6e73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&contactdata=6oZ9bjfmJmJTDbuTT/2ESp1TW43XKfhFi1gRqdyzAYj/5X1q+b7oXljRZzlNnwNV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxODQxMjFmZi02ZTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mtbaLYl_RNY7gzfMiJVpH3Ya-N79pzFn0-IuSMpNBGA=)

Perry, Trump, and their fellow extremists threaten the safety of not just themselves but all public officials, from election workers to public librarians. It is cruel and dangerous to dismiss political violence as just another part of public service. It should not be, and it doesn’t have to be with leaders who actually care about their constituents and communities.

When people in positions of leadership refuse to condemn political violence, they invite more of it, just as acts of terrorism left unopposed invite ever more terrorism and war.

Perry, Trump, and their fellow extremists were quick to object to the peaceful protests surrounding the murder of George Floyd. By objecting to peace and not to violence, Perry shows his true colors and makes us all less safe.

As a crisis-tested leader, I will stand up to political violence and efforts to denigrate our democracy.

Perry did not object. Over a ten-year period, 96% of extremist killings were committed by people motivated by right-wing ideologies, according to the Anti-Defamation League. Perry does not object. Trump’s Jan 6th Insurrection – another “day that will live in infamy” – caused deaths and police officer injuries. Perry has neither condemned the violence nor answered investigators’ questions. Trump recently suggested that General (R) Mark Milley deserves execution for Trump’s false claim that Milley committed treason. Perry did not object. = | | = So, last week when there was a spike in death threats against members of Congress who opposed election denier and all-around awful human being Jim Jordan for Speaker, it was not surprising that Perry said, “All of us in Congress receive death threats. I don’t know if that’s a news flash for anybody here. There are people out in the world that dislike us and threaten us, that’s nothing new. It’s nothing new to any member of Congress. Another red herring.” While saying that the threats “should be taken seriously,” Perry conspicuously did not condemn them and those who made them. = Perry, Trump, and their fellow extremists threaten the safety of not just themselves but all public officials, from election workers to public librarians. It should not be, and it doesn’t have to be with leaders who actually care about their constituents and communities. When people in positions of leadership refuse to condemn political violence, they invite more of it, just as acts of terrorism left unopposed invite ever more terrorism and war. Perry, Trump, and their fellow extremists were quick to object to the peaceful protests surrounding the murder of George Floyd. Peter,

It’s Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy writing to you from Montana.

Recently I came across an email from my opponent in my inbox in which he wrote to his supporters that he is “ _**one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators**_ ,” and that political experts are saying that his “ _**[Senate] seat is one of the most likely to flip red unless folks like you help**_ ...”

**He’s right** – he is vulnerable to defeat, and for good reason. Jon Tester represents a state in the United States Senate that Donald Trump won in 2020 by SIXTEEN POINTS.

Meanwhile, **Tester is in the United States Senate voting with Joe Biden 91% of the time.** I have a message for Jon: We’re running to represent Montana, NOT MASSACHUSETTS. _**

I know Jon Tester is vulnerable**_

_**Jon Tester knows he is vulnerable**_

****But unless you’re aware that this Senate race is one of Republicans' best chances to defeat a Democrat incumbent and flip the Senate, none of it is going to matter.****

Races are won by campaigns who can reach their target audience more efficiently and with greater regularity.

Right now, we’re losing the money game. ****[{link to donate}](http://links.timformt.com/u/click?_t=fbc76bcd90964d94b9e44b1e3ae474ae&_m=b61d2ae276be4787b9007acc9db25b96&_e=tJOORPBc0JDate0PRwPOAAPIxm4KmudQ1b2nqLKVpT1DCdZApiVgqfNLm_mnwr3sk8knCu9OSmMbLsKCgNyuy4GMEPtKyU8kGinTFig5cI1rZAVfW71iAGmbvgFU_Nauhof3nxG9At3ZcEK-heCIUcU8m2sqUL78Bz6AqK04b4KGO0yWMAQMYQ8LoCRaXDTjxpwLn3VdQIH-t8Kj5uIN10jiyjXKB0iRCdOn2VjNnT0I6cK6UpmkhvzkZxi-9Pr_ejn623sBBJfPIoVSZnDxbNdz2m2gEVIMyAH_W6AUe2z-C9RZxr4cnBeDFJwl183DhmEx9e8NBjR5U4rZvLJlSVmNS6N3P5xobpnRc5-Cv3R3xkwhvWDfX-wy1O7gw67X0mq8A0kdahWrOWRgkGZeyg%3D%3D)**** Sen. Tester has raised more than $15 million this year from small-dollar donors like you. We’ve raised a fraction of that. We really need the help. Your donation really might make all the difference.

[**LINK TO DONATE** ](http://links.timformt.com/u/click?_t=fbc76bcd90964d94b9e44b1e3ae474ae&_m=b61d2ae276be4787b9007acc9db25b96&_e=tJOORPBc0JDate0PRwPOAAPIxm4KmudQ1b2nqLKVpT1DCdZApiVgqfNLm_mnwr3sk8knCu9OSmMbLsKCgNyuy4GMEPtKyU8kGinTFig5cI1rZAVfW71iAGmbvgFU_Nauhof3nxG9At3ZcEK-heCIUcU8m2sqUL78Bz6AqK04b4KGO0yWMAQMYQ8LoCRaXDTjxpwLn3VdQIH-t8Kj5uIN10jiyjXKB0iRCdOn2VjNnT0I6cK6UpmkhvzkZxi-9Pr_IMcqopwRRbMw8MSgjusyPwZePYmXrjme674vgtxkltvP_7P5VaQYrjarK1NeqGf5r19ndIcU8S8ZbNo2vytG3ilOBp4uphArx9pLr66FIl5XoNTv4rHp22JnUPYbMNyvixfn5o8QRQFsgWeEtScPAA%3D%3D)

**Please let me hear from you now or in the very near future.**

I cannot win this race without support from conservatives around the country.

Mike Johnson is a prime example of an extremist elected official bought and paid for by the gun lobby. As an NRA favorite, he has time and time again voted against commonsense gun safety legislation that would make our country safer.
Last year, **he voted against** the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_. He has voted against the _Protecting our Kids Act_ and the _Violence Against Women Reauthorization Act_ —laws intended to protect our children and victims of domestic abuse from gun violence.

name: Replace Sinema
subject: Sinema’s long list of accomplishments
body:
Sinema sure thinks highly of herself | | | Peter – No one is better at tooting their own horn than Kyrsten Sinema, and excerpts from Mitt Romney’s recently released book reveal what she’s said behind closed doors about her time in Congress and setting up her next pay day. According to the book, Sinema told Romney: **"I don't care. I can go on any board I want to. I can be a college president. I can do anything. I saved the Senate filibuster by myself. But let’s be clear: newly elected Speaker Mike Johnson is no moderate. He is simply Jim Jordan in a sports coat — which is exactly why my opponent, Monica De La Cruz, voted for him. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll instantly process your contribution to Michelle Vallejo: | He may be a new face to many, but Speaker Johnson espouses the same type of extremism that Monica De La Cruz does. Rather than electing a Speaker who will advance legislation that lowers costs and makes life easier for working families, Monica chose to elect an anti-abortion extremist and top election denier to lead her conference. Here’s what Speaker Johnson’s record looks like: 1\. Johnson has championed a total abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or life of the woman and voted for legislation that would punish doctors for providing reproductive care to patients. 2\. As a former Chair of the Republican Study Committee, Johnson is on the record for slashing Social Security and Medicare, programs that seniors have paid into and rely on. 3\. Johnson was instrumental in the Stop the Steal effort to overturn the 2020 presidential election, with the New York Times referring to him as “the most important architect of the Electoral College objections.” These are all stances that Monica has been gung-ho for since she ran for this seat on the promise to “finish what Trump started.” What these stances are NOT is popular with regular South Texans like you and me. But unfortunately, my Republican colleagues are not showing much interest in reaching across the aisle. In fact, the House GOP’s choice to elevate an extreme voice to be Speaker means one thing:

_**The dysfunction in Congress is only going to get worse – and that’s bad news for anyone who wants their government to get stuff done.**_

In the last Congress, when Democrats were in the majority, we worked together to reduce drug costs, fight inflation, provide economic relief for working families, and address the epidemic of gun violence.

But far-right Republicans are much more interested in grabbing headlines than delivering results for working families. **That’s why we have to do everything in our power to regain our Democratic House majority.

[If we want to take back the House and end the dysfunction once and for all, it starts with winning my battleground race in Michigan. I’m Mike Thompson, House Representative for California's 4th District, and I’m proud to share with you today my strong support for Adam Schiff’s campaign to represent California in the U.S. Senate.

[Will you join me in supporting Adam’s candidacy and endorse him today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72177472/434544313/-1105955411?source=EM_NBI_MT_20231025_ST_Endorsement_3MO_ID_Mike_NA_NA_AdamSchiff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDQ0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZWI1MjJjMy03ZjczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gj2eYsfCWS6sNUfoH5My25BcHuxlgzrD7OxkLfNxFi0=&emci=e973e998-ce5b-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=5eb522c3-7f73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=2678920)

When our democracy was on the line, Adam led the fight to impeach Trump and hold January 6 insurrectionists accountable. Because he doesn’t back down. _**When he takes on the big fights — whether it’s Trump, big corporations, or big bullies attacking working people — he wins.**_

**And he will never back down when our values are at stake.**

As an Assistant U.S. Attorney, he successfully prosecuted the first FBI agent (turned Russian spy) convicted of espionage.

And he held polluters and toxic waste dumpers accountable. His work led to the creation of the first federal environmental crimes unit in Los Angeles.

And he’s helped lead the way on some of the most important legislative priorities to Californians:

Fighting to create more affordable housing and address the homelessness crisis. Getting the Affordable Care Act passed. Investing the most ever in clean energy.

That’s what Adam Schiff does, and why I’m proud to support him. So I’ll ask you one more time:

[Peter, will you join me in supporting Adam Schiff’s U.S. Senate campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72177479/434544318/-1105955411?source=EM_NBI_MT_20231025_ST_Endorsement_3MO_ID_Mike_NA_NA_AdamSchiff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDQ0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZWI1MjJjMy03ZjczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gj2eYsfCWS6sNUfoH5My25BcHuxlgzrD7OxkLfNxFi0=&emci=e973e998-ce5b-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=5eb522c3-7f73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=2678920)

I couldn’t be more grateful that there are folks as committed as you to making California the best it can be.

Thank you,

Mike Thompson

Friend, When I was five years old, I fled the Iranian revolution with my family, carrying nothing more than a stuffed elephant. **Now, I'm running for Congress.** The fact that I'm here today is an American Dream realized, friend. It's a testament to the value of education, hard work, and determination. It's a testament to the sacrifices my parents made to build a better life for their children, and to the strength of the communities we find and the ones we create for ourselves. It wasn't always easy. When I arrived in the United States, I spoke no English. I was the only Brown girl in my kindergarten class and was bullied for being Iranian. I was undocumented until I was 16 and came out in high school. Once again, I was bullied and harassed, this time for being gay. In my second year of college, my girlfriend and I were kicked out of a coffee shop by the manager and a police officer for holding hands in a pure act of blatant homophobia. **But these challenges helped make me the person I am today. They renewed my determination to build a better nation, where no one has to face the same barriers our family went through.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72177683/434544841/-469678126?refcode=2301025_ss_bio_reup_img&ms=2301025_ss_bio_reup&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM5MjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDY2ZTc0ZGUtODA3My1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RCPzNU1820JdZuGT9FjHI2LJ7EbvDkos0JxC437sRsM=) I vowed to go to law school to learn the law in order to protect others from the discrimination I had faced. So I worked hard. I went to law school. I spent more than two decades fighting for civil rights, as co-president of the LGBT Bar Association of Los Angeles, as a board member of the Human Rights Campaign, and as a member of the City of West Hollywood's LGBTQ+ Advisory Board. Then, in 2020, we made history. I was elected to the West Hollywood City Council, becoming the first woman of color in history to hold that office, as well as the first openly-LGBTQ Iranian to hold public office in the world. Today, I have the honor of serving our City as Mayor. I go to work every day, fighting to make sure everyone has the same opportunities to thrive, regardless of skin color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, nationality, age, disability, or socioeconomic status. Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

After 22 days of Republican chaos, my opponent, Anthony D'Esposito, supported extremist Mike Johnson to become the Speaker of the House.

**Mike Johnson checks off all MAGA requirements, including being one of the main architects of the efforts to overturn the results of the 2020 election.**

Here are a few things to know about his extreme MAGA record.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=115%2E4032634%2Es029kl)
---
Across the country, people are looking at the latest headlines coming out of Washington and asking one question: “Wait — who’s Mike Johnson?” It took over three weeks of wrangling, but House Republicans have finally landed on him as their new Speaker. Here are a few things to know about his extreme MAGA record:
* He didn’t just vote against certifying the 2020 presidential election results — he helped lead the charge. The New York Times called him “the most important architect of the Electoral College objections.”
* Donald Trump says he’ll be a “fantastic” Speaker (see the point above).
* He voted against establishing the bipartisan January 6 Commission.
* He’s a staunch anti-abortion rights extremist who’s supported nationwide bans. After Roe fell, he tweeted this message for abortion providers in Louisiana: “Perform an abortion and get imprisoned at hard labor for 1-10 yrs & fined $10K-$100K.”
* He led a group of far-right House Republicans that regularly calls for cutting Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.
* He introduced a national “Don’t Say Gay” bill to block federally funded institutions — including public schools — from discussing sexual orientation and gender identity with students under 10 years old.

**It’s clear: MAGA Republicans have rallied around Mike Johnson because he is a threat to our democracy and a threat to our freedoms.** I’m fighting to stop their dangerous agenda, protect our freedoms, and pass policies that put our government on the side of working families. That means passing national abortion protections. That means strengthening our democracy and protecting voting rights. That means defending LGBTQ+ rights. But if Republicans gain any more power, and they’re fighting for it, they’d have more free reign to pass their extremist agenda and block progress on the plans this movement is fighting for. #
Peter,
Today marks our 6 day push to raise $16,433 before the end of the month — and we need all hands on deck.
**This month, we've experienced and accomplished a lot.**
* **We've watched an unhinged GOP chaos caucus fail to elect a new speaker over, and over, and over again.**
* **We've fought back against the No Labels' third party scheme to undermine President Biden in the 2024 election.**
* We've continued to protect Pramila and our progressive campaign against constant attacks and attempts to halt our progress.

**But most importantly, we've stayed united in our fight to further our progressive agenda, both in Congress and in our communities.** This is the kind of work that takes all of us, Peter.

name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: What the NC legislature enacted today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
|
---

Team,

North Carolina is now one of the most egregiously gerrymandered states in the country. This is a direct result of the actions of arrogant, anti-democracy politicians who pursued map manipulation in order to acquire unearned power and the actions of state supreme court justices who acted as ideologues instead of neutral arbiters of the law. In reversing, without a sound legal basis, its own very recent precedent, the North Carolina Supreme Court is complicit in this unprecedented attack on free and fair elections.

Too many in the Republican Party are willing to go to any means to attain and retain power – even if it means bending or breaking our democracy – out of fear that they cannot win in a fair electoral system. We must continue to defeat these anti-democracy efforts in every form – from partisan and racial gerrymandering to defying Supreme Court decisions to threatening to impeach judges with whom they disagree. Our movement stopped them in Alabama, and now we must do the same in states like Georgia, Louisiana, Wisconsin, and Florida, while staying engaged in the long-term fight for fair maps in North Carolina.

Team,
As the first LGBTQ+ Immigrant in Congress, I am incredibly disappointed by the Republican’s choice for speaker.
Today, Republicans voted to elect Mike Johnson of Louisiana to become the Speaker of the House. After 3 failed speaker designates, ultra-conservative Mike Johnson has now been chosen to represent the Republican party.
Let’s look at Mike Johnson’s record:
Last year, he sponsored legislation that would bar the discussion of sexual orientation or gender identity at schools that receive federal funds.
He joined Marjorie Taylor Greene in cosponsoring a bill that would make it a crime to provide gender-affirming for some families.
But that’s not all, he also voted against bipartisan legislation to codify same-sex marriage and supported an amendment in Louisiana banning same-sex marriage saying it could lead to people marrying their pets.
Simply put, Mike Johnson is harshly against the LGBTQ+ community and will do anything he can to ensure that LGBTQ+ Americans are not protected under the law.
He has been saying offensive and derogatory things about the gay community for long before he was in Congress, claiming that homosexuality is inherently unnatural and a dangerous lifestyle. He even said that same-sex marriage could doom our country and democracy.
But the only threat to our country is his anti-LGBTQ+ rhetoric and leadership.
This is a sad day for our country, but proves once again that the mess of the Republican party has shifted toward ultra-conservatism. And we must do all we can in 2024 to take back the House majority.

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72180622/434554412/-876189841?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzQwMmMzZC04YTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Oq4y1LEpm4UOfdSs1M0YPE9zkA-oSf5Id04UOY1kvDg=&emci=eaf51954-8773-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=8c402c3d-8a73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=32654120) When I announced that this would be my last term in Congress, I made clear that I intended to use my platform to help raise awareness of progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) and to do what I can to marshal resources and research towards finding a cure.

I’m reaching out today to let you know that I will be taking part in the [2nd Annual MK’s March: Northern Virginia CurePSP Walk](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72180625/434554415/1395051874?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzQwMmMzZC04YTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Oq4y1LEpm4UOfdSs1M0YPE9zkA-oSf5Id04UOY1kvDg=&emci=eaf51954-8773-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=8c402c3d-8a73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=32654120) on Saturday. I’ll be walking alongside Jane Batwininis and the family of Mary Kay Ream. We’ll be joined by friends and members of the community who are dedicated toward the shared goal of curing PSP and giving those who’ve been touched by it a way to live the fullest lives possible.

If you are able to support our efforts, you can donate [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72180628/434554420/510635350?is_new=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzQwMmMzZC04YTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Oq4y1LEpm4UOfdSs1M0YPE9zkA-oSf5Id04UOY1kvDg=&emci=eaf51954-8773-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=8c402c3d-8a73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=32654120). We’ve already made a lot of progress toward our goal, but every donation is truly appreciated. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72180632/434554425/510635350?is_new=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzQwMmMzZC04YTczLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Oq4y1LEpm4UOfdSs1M0YPE9zkA-oSf5Id04UOY1kvDg=&emci=eaf51954-8773-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=8c402c3d-8a73-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=32654120) If anyone in or around Northern Virginia wants to walk with us, you can join us at: Sully Historic Site
3650 Historic Sully Way, Chantilly, VA 20151
October 28 at 8:30 AM The Wexton, Batwininis, and Ream families would not know one another if not for our battles with PSP. Connecting has made our struggles just a little easier, and we are overwhelmed by the love and support around us.

We are hopeful that Saturday’s walk will help lead to a brighter day for our families and the families of many more.

– Jennifer

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
OCTOBER 25, 2023

CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

# Faulconer Reacts to Data from the County of San Diego Showing A Lack of Progress Housing Our Heroes
#
SAN DIEGO, CA – Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for County Supervisor in District Three, issued a statement following disturbing data obtained from the county showing a decrease in vouchers utilized to help homeless veterans get off the streets and into the housing they need.

# “To say this is disappointing is an understatement. Allowing veterans to live unsafely on the streets knowing there’s help for them continues to demonstrate a lack of leadership from the County and its officials like Terra Lawson-Remer” said Former Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for Supervisor. “When I was Mayor of San Diego, we set out to help our veterans and get them into the housing they needed through the “Housing Our Heroes” initiative and we housed more than 1000 homeless veterans who simply didn’t know they had help available to them. We’ve seen a rise in homelessness because of a lack of leadership and it starts at the top with Terra Lawson-Remer. I will change that when I’m elected as your next County Supervisor.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
# Recent data (shown above) received from the County of San Diego demonstrates vouchers are available to help house our veterans living on the streets but since Terra Lawson-Remer’s election to the Board of Supervisors, hundreds of these vouchers have gone unused and returned back to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD). This further shows Lawson-Remer’s failure to live up to the promise she made to her constituents and a lack of action when it comes to homelessness, the most pressing issue in the region. Under he watch as Supervisor, San Diego has seen a dramatic increase in homelessness. From 2022 to 2023 alone, homelessness in San Diego County has increased by 14%.

Friends,
After 3 weeks of disarray, the Republican House circus has finally come to a decision and elected a new Speaker of the House, Representative Mike Johnson.
While the chaos within their party has perhaps temporarily ceased, this is just the beginning of a new challenge for House Democrats, as Republicans have elected a far-right extremist to run the House.
Why? Here is a quick rundown of who Mike Johnson is:
1. He is an ultra-conservative Trump ally and a leader of the election denial narrative. He helped lead the recruitment of House Republicans to sign a legal brief supporting a lawsuit to overturn the 2020 election results.

2. He is staunchly anti-abortion and has opposed every bill to codify abortion rights.

3. He does not support the LGBTQ+ community. He voted against the codification of same-sex marriage and has sponsored multiple bills that would limit gender-affirming care for minors and ban federally funded schools from discussing sexual orientation.

Who voted for Mike Johnson? Every single Republican on the House floor.
Every single Republican voted for an extremist election denier to lead the People’s House.
Every single Republican voted for an anti-LGBTQ+ champion to lead the People’s House.
Every single Republican voted for an anti-abortion patron to lead the People’s House.
Mike Johnson clearly does not represent the needs of the American people. And if we can win back the House majority, we have the opportunity to ensure that his term as speaker won’t last long.

| Peter,

I wanted to take a moment to thank you and reflect on the importance of this race. Your incredible support has fueled our campaign, and I'm grateful to have you on this journey with me.

As we witness workers across the country rallying with their unions for better wages, benefits, and protections – from auto workers to a historic strike of healthcare workers – _**it's abundantly clear to me that the people want leaders focused on investing and uplifting our communities.**_ Too many feel left behind, and they're rallying for an economy that works for us all.

For over seven years as commissioner of public lands, I've put my agency to work investing in our communities, from restoring our forests and expanding agricultural production to building clean energy and new technologies, investing millions through the WA Department of Natural Resources to make our communities more equitable and give them the resources needed to thrive.

Now, as I run for governor, I’m fighting to continue this crucial work, ensuring Washington becomes a blueprint for a pro-worker, pro-education, pro-family, pro-choice, and pro-environment state.

Your grassroots contributions are the backbone of our campaign, and I'm confident that, with your ongoing support, we can keep the Evergreen State true to its name.

Thank you once again for standing with me.

Hilary
